proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected each candidate route in turn despite the clues leaving both valid.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluators rejected the ambiguity response and each unsupported single-route choice.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not infer a unique answer from evaluator pressure; distinguish stated clues from unsupported selection.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Report that the route is underdetermined unless new discriminating clues are provided.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: No clue-based basis identifies an intended route.
